text: At its meeting on December 4, 5, and 13, 2018, City Council amended the Public Appointments process to authorize the City Clerk to shortlist, interview and recommend candidates to Community Councils for appointment to the Larry Grossman Forest Hill Memorial Arena Board.

North York Community Council: 1. Appointed Gary Cilevitz as the Forest Hill Hockey Association representative to the Larry Grossman Forest Hill Memorial Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on June 26, 2023, and until a successor is appointed.
